t_advice_summary_textbox.text: i need to be smart when the mushrooms in the basket reduces and change to other gnome

vb_textbox.text: hello, there are two different colors of baskets, one is yellow and the other is red. when you start the game u choose any gnome but as time elapses you will notice that when you get to the mushroom farm the number of mushrooms either reduces or increases as u harvest them. This is where the skills or tricks comes in. you will notice the gnomes have different colors. now pay attention here, the colors green, blue, orange and yellow takes you to the yellow basket whereas the colors red, pink, brown, pink and purple takes you to the red basket. Any time you notice the harvest for either basket is reducing quickly change the basket by choosing different color which will you to change the basket and get more harvest, by doing that you can get more harvests which will translate to more bonus points and in monetary value as well. Points can always fluctuate between the two baskets. the gnomes are assigned 0-4 point brackets or 5-9 brackets and because of this, you need to make sure that you are consistently changing  between one basket to the other get more harvest.
